explanation: One third is 0.333... recurring, and three thirds make 1, so 0.999... must equal 1. There is no number between them.

claims.text: The recurring decimal 0.999... is exactly equal to 1.
One third equals 0.333... recurring, and three times one third is 1.
There is no real number between 0.999... and 1.
